covered.rule: Mail: quoted settings (5 wrong answers, retry 3, DOB first, fourth business day, no same-day callbacks) are obsolete
covered.where: identity.wrong_answer_limit, promise_write.retry_on_failure, identity.requirements, bands[1].deadline, third_party.callback.days (all follow M41)

covered.rule: P11 1: first sentence automated assistant of Bank 1, call recorded; ask with title and last name
P11 2: never say collections, debt, payment, credit card, loan before verification
P11 3: ask once more, then no-contact / unclear
P11 4: robot reply / scam reply and continue
P11 5: third party, say nothing, ask when reachable
P11 6 + M41 E: callback today or next business day, 12:00-17:30, after now, no-contact / cb-set
P11 7: outside window ask once more, else no-contact / cb-none
P11 8: wrong number no-contact / wrong-no
P11 9: deceased, 'I am sorry for your loss.'
P11 10: refuses to talk no-ptp / refuses
P11 11 + M41 A: question order phone_last4, date_of_birth, postcode, birth_year; formats kept
P11 12 + M41 A: 3 wrong answers total, wrong_answers_left
P11 13: 'Please use the mobile app or visit a branch.' id-fail / exhausted
P11 14: explain once, second refusal id-fail / would-not-answer
P11 15/29 + M41 D: human -> front-desk immediately, escalated / agent
P11 16: Mon-Sat business days, holidays 2026-10-14, 2026-10-15
P11 17: next <weekday> = following week
P11 18: collections team intro; up to 2 products; state all; ask once pay all today
P11 19: product names; floor fixed 75.00
P11 20: full first, never ask how much, floor once with 'the rest stays overdue'
P11 21: promise date rules
P11 22 band1: last business day of next month, 2 attempts
P11 22 band2 + M41 B: third business day after today, 2 attempts
P11 23: attempt 1 full on last business day this week/next, floor if full refused; attempt 2 floor on deadline
P11 24: no promise noted refuses
P11 25: already paid sentence, note already-paid, continue
P11 26: dispute note disputes, continue
P11 27: hardship sympathy, welfare offer, decline no-ptp / vulnerable, record promise
P11 28: restructuring plans, escalated / plans, promises stay
P11 30: read-back 'Do you confirm?', one promise per product
P11 31: text message sentence after successful write
P11 32 + M41 C: retry once, then no-ptp / tool-error
P11 33: 'You can change it in the mobile app.'
P11 34: several products, clamp common date, one read-back, transfer keeps promise
P11 35: one note per product without promise, none on transfer
P11 36 / Code list C: outcome-reason table, goodbye before close_call
P11 37: precedence
covered.where: outcomes.promise_outcome, transfer_outcome, transfer_overrides_promise, paid_outcome, all_paid_closes_as_paid, no_promise_outcome, no_promise_reason_from_first_non_paid_note

fixed: phrases.opening: removed the leading 'Hello,' because the documents only give the content (automated assistant of Bank 1, call is recorded), and that greeting word was not in the source.
phrases.today_question: changed to 'Can you pay all of it today?' to match P11 rule 18 ('ask once whether they can pay all of it today') instead of the paraphrase 'full past-due amount'.
Source spans: added the P11 text that the memo keeps (phone_last4 format, band2 attempt count, human queue/outcome, confirm phrase) to the relevant source fields. No values changed.
unresolved: The API returns a verify_identity hint `day_month_swapped`, but the documents give no reply for it (identity.requirements[date_of_birth].hint_reply left empty).
No general 'cannot answer' sentence is dictated. Rule 32's 'say you could not record it' (failed write) has no dedicated phrase field.
The documents do not say what to do when a deadline is already in the past, so dates.past_deadline is left at its default.
